description.summary: You fill your target’s mind with a blaring cacophony of discordant sounds, making it hard for the target to act and concentrate.
description.value: You fill your target’s mind with a blaring cacophony of discordant sounds, making it hard for the target to act and concentrate. The creature gains the Nauseated status effect for the duration of the song if it fails its Will save. Nauseated: Creatures with the nauseated condition experience stomach distress. Nauseated creatures are unable to attack, cast spells, concentrate on spells, or do anything else requiring attention. The only action such a character can take is a single move action per turn.
